nodes.text:
HMPV is a common respiratory virus, especially during peak seasons. While it can cause illness, especially in young children and older adults, there's no need to panic. Focus on prevention:
•Wash hands often
•Avoid close contact with sick people
•Stay home if you're sick
#HMPV
